rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something is boring or wearisome, such as a long story.

example.english: The story in this movie is so tiresome that I fell asleep watching it.
example.traditional: 呢套戲個故仔太悶，我睇到瞓着咗。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 go3 gu2 zai2 taai3 mun6 ngo5 tai2 dou3 fan3 zoek3 zo2

rows.note: Use this when the thing is tiresome because it takes physical or mental effort rather than because it is boring.

example.english: Moving so many boxes of books upstairs is really tiresome.
example.traditional: 搬咁多箱書上樓真係辛苦。
example.jyutping: bun1 gam3 do1 soeng1 syu1 soeng5 lau2 zan1 hai6 san1 fu2

rows.note: Use this when the tiresome thing is irritating, troublesome, or repeatedly bothersome.

example.english: Their calling every day to ask the same thing is really tiresome.
example.traditional: 佢日日打嚟問同一樣嘢，真係好煩。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat6 jat6 daa2 lai4 man6 tung4 jat1 joeng6 je5 zan1 hai6 hou2 faan4
